newsitem.title: USA: Weyerhaeuser Q3 bolstered by lumber prices.
newsitem.headline: Weyerhaeuser Q3 bolstered by lumber prices.

text.p: Weyerhaeuser Co said on Tuesday that strong lumber and improving pulp prices helped to offset a decline in earnings caused by weak paper and packaging markets.

"Our 1996 third quarter results reflected strong lumber prices in both domestic and Japanese markets, and improving pulp prices," John Creighton Jr., president and chief executive of Weyerhaeuser, said in a statement.
"The higher volumes and lower operating costs achieved by our business improvement plans helped offset continuing weak pricing in paper and packaging products," he said.
